exposure: method of repair for perineal tears
use of delayed absorbable suture material
outcome: injuries complicated by instrumental vaginal deliveries
cohort: The study comprised medical records from January 2008 to December 2018 of women having singleton term vaginal delivery and sustaining obstetric anal sphincter injuries.
finding: The frequency of obstetric anal sphincter injuries remained similar to a previous audit despite an increase in deliveries, while documentation, suture material use, and follow-up practices for tear management significantly improved.
mod_finding: The use of vacuum vaginal delivery increased, but there was a decrease in injuries complicated by instrumental vaginal deliveries (p<0.05).
